blas.runtime_config: OpenBLAS 0.3.23.dev  USE64BITINT DYNAMIC_ARCH NO_AFFINITY SkylakeX MAX_THREADS=64

blas.name: openblas64
blas.openblas configuration: USE_64BITINT=1 DYNAMIC_ARCH=1 DYNAMIC_OLDER= NO_CBLAS= NO_LAPACK= NO_LAPACKE= NO_AFFINITY=1 USE_OPENMP= HASWELL MAX_THREADS=2

pass_rule_text.A_first_acquisition: every QUAL world LEARNED_A under the shared W_A; median over QUAL worlds of nmse_A(W_A) <= 0.25
pass_rule_text.B_stage_acquisition: selected candidate: every QUAL world LEARNED_s at every stage s in B, C, D
pass_rule_text.C_sequence_retention: selected candidate: every QUAL world RETAINED_t_at_s for every stage s and every earlier t (central gate; with B: every QUAL world SEQUENCE_HELD)
pass_rule_text.D_no_catastrophe: selected candidate: no CATASTROPHIC_t_at_s in any QUAL world, stage or earlier experience
pass_rule_text.E_joint_quality: selected candidate: median over QUAL worlds of final_mean_nmse <= 0.25
pass_rule_text.F_joint_state: selected candidate: at every stage one executor created from W_s answers all four experiences' held-out inputs (state digest recorded); no task label reaches a query (structural)
pass_rule_text.G_state_causality: selected candidate, every QUAL world: (i) an executor restored from the snapshot of the executor holding W_D reproduces its responses bitwise and an executor created from W0 reproduces the untaught responses bitwise; (ii) ablation state_removed: SEQUENCE_HELD in at most 25% of QUAL worlds and its median final_earlier_mean_nmse >= 2 x the candidate's; (iii) ablation extended_state_transplant_at_B continues bitwise equal to the uninterrupted run in every QUAL world (and in a clean process for qual-0000); (iv) ablation consolidation_reset_at_B: A and B both RETAINED at D in at most 25% of QUAL worlds
pass_rule_text.H_no_external_answer_store: selected candidate: (i) consolidation receives W and the current experience's inputs only (structural; no target, label or task identity); (ii) no row is stored beyond the current learn call; (iii) persistent_extra_bytes identical after every stage; (iv) every query reads W only
pass_rule_text.I_determinism: selected candidate, world qual-0000: the full pipeline twice in process and once in a clean process from the frozen specification yields identical W and consolidation-state digests at every stage and identical metrics
pass_rule_text.J_control_honesty: M1 is reported as EXTERNAL_MEMORY_CONTROL and C1R as REFERENCE; neither is the selected candidate
pass_rule_text.K_capacity_accounting: every mechanism reports persistent extra bytes per stage, analytic per-step operations and (M1) stored-experience bytes
pass_rule_text.L_native_feasibility: selected candidate: persistent state fixed-size and independent of the number of experiences and of N beyond W; analytic hot-path extra operations per step <= 64 x G1's (82,944 at R = 64); cold-path operations per consolidation <= 1e10; no stored rows; recorded in the evidence
pass_rule_text.M_numerical_robustness: the QUAL computation that decides validity, mechanics and gates is repeated, within the one QUAL execution, in child processes with OpenBLAS forced to the Prescott and the Haswell kernel (single thread); validity, mechanics, gates, disposition, outcome and every per-mechanism count equal the primary run's (no float or W digest compared)
pass_rule_text.disposition: MECHANICS_FAIL if any mechanics check fails. Else TASK_INVALID_UNDER_QUAL (OUTCOME_V) if any validity condition fails. Else RETENTION_SUPPORTED_UNDER_FROZEN_SYNTHETIC_REGIME (OUTCOME_A) if gates A-M hold for the selected candidate. Else PARTIAL_REDUCTION (OUTCOME_C) if the selected candidate is SEQUENCE_HELD in more QUAL worlds than M0 and its median final_earlier_mean_nmse <= 0.5 x M0's. Else REPLAY_ONLY (OUTCOME_B) if M1 is SEQUENCE_HELD in every QUAL world. Else NO_MATERIAL_IMPROVEMENT (OUTCOME_D). DEV may end earlier as TASK_INVALID_ON_DEV (no freeze, no QUAL). M1, C1R and the non-selected candidates are always reported and never change the disposition. Only the DEV-selected candidate can obtain OUTCOME_A; no other mechanism can be promoted from this experiment. A failure is recorded as it is; a repair is a new experiment version

qualifiers.CAPACITY_SCOPE: always: retention is claimed only for jointly realizable aliasing-conflict sequences of this family
qualifiers.EXCEEDS_R0_REFERENCE: the selected candidate is SEQUENCE_HELD in more QUAL worlds than C1R, or in as many with a smaller median final_mean_nmse
qualifiers.MICROSTATE_EFFECT: K3 and K1 differ in SEQUENCE_HELD count or by more than 2x in median final_earlier_mean_nmse (reported whichever is selected)
qualifiers.R0_REFERENCE_ALSO_SUFFICIENT: C1R meets gates B, C, D and E
